message: Command `grep -rn "hex_to_u32_nocheck" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/simdjson/ --include="*.h" --include="*.cpp" | head -20` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: The crash is in `hex_to_u32_nocheck` which reads `src[0]`, `src[1]`, `src[2]`, `src[3]` - this reads 4 bytes from the source. The issue is likely an out-of-bounds read when parsing a truncated `\uXXXX` escape sequence at the end of the input. Let me look at where `hex_to_u32_nocheck` is called.
